'''Talor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Along with fellow Moffs [[Ganthus]] and [[Sorin]] he was present onboard the [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']] when it was boarded by a group of thieves including the [[Voidhound]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] found the Moffs conversing in the vaults on the ship, when [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harridax Kirill]] opened fire on the ship with the intention to kill everyone on board. Talor and other Moffs perished, but the thieves escaped.
